title: Ophthalmologists, Except Pediatric
description: Diagnose and perform surgery to treat and help prevent disorders and diseases of the eye. May also provide vision services for treatment including glasses and contacts.

tasks.text: Prescribe or administer topical or systemic medications to treat ophthalmic conditions and to manage pain.
Perform ophthalmic surgeries such as cataract, glaucoma, refractive, corneal, vitro-retinal, eye muscle, or oculoplastic surgeries.
Refer patients for more specialized treatments when conditions exceed the experience, expertise, or scope of practice of practitioner.
Perform laser surgeries to alter, remove, reshape, or replace ocular tissue.
Develop or implement plans and procedures for ophthalmologic services.
Develop treatment plans based on patients' histories and goals, the nature and severity of disorders, and treatment risks and benefits.

clusters.label: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Educate patients about maintenance and promotion of healthy vision.
Provide ophthalmic consultation to other medical professionals.
Prescribe corrective lenses such as glasses or contact lenses.
Prescribe ophthalmologic treatments or therapies such as chemotherapy, cryotherapy, or low vision therapy.
Perform comprehensive examinations of the visual system to determine the nature or extent of ocular disorders.
Diagnose or treat injuries, disorders, or diseases of the eye and eye structures including the cornea, sclera, conjunctiva, or eyelids.
Provide or direct the provision of postoperative care.
Document or evaluate patients' medical histories.
Perform, order, or interpret the results of diagnostic or clinical tests.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of health professionals to provide optimal patient care.
Instruct interns, residents, or others in ophthalmologic procedures and techniques.
Conduct clinical or laboratory-based research in ophthalmology.

skills.name: Medical software
skills.def: Software to evaluate, plan, or redesign healthcare procedures. May include reporting or visualization features. Examples: Allscripts PM, athenahealth athenaCollector, Automatic Data Processing AdvancedMD EHR, Benchmark Systems Benchmark Clinical EHR.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Word processing software
skills.def: Software to create, edit, store, or print documents. Examples: Microsoft Word.

skills.name: Electronic mail software
skills.def: Software to compose, send, or receive email. Examples: Email software.

skills.name: Analytical or scientific software
skills.def: Software to capture data, perform analysis, or generate reports or visualizations to support scientific research. Examples: Ophthalmic imaging software.
